{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Auto checkpoint cleanup - keep only latest 2 _chkpt dirs per experiment
LOG="/root/cleanup_checkpoints.log"
echo "$(date): Starting cleanup" >> "$LOG"

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints"

for exp_dir in "$CKPT_BASE"/*/; do
    [ -d "$exp_dir" ] || continue
    exp_name=$(basename "$exp_dir")

    # Find all *_chkpt directories, extract step number, sort ascending
    mapfile -t chkpts < <(
        find "$exp_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*_chkpt" | while read d; do
            # Extract step number: last segment before _chkpt (e.g. --50000_chkpt -> 50000)
            num=$(basename "$d" | grep -oP '\d+(?=_chkpt$)')
            [ -n "$num" ] && echo "$num $d"
        done | sort -k1 -n | awk '{print $2}'
    )

    count=${#chkpts[@]}
    if [ "$count" -gt 2 ]; then
        delete_count=$((count - 2))
        echo "$(date): $exp_name has $count checkpoints, deleting $delete_count oldest" >> "$LOG"
        for ((i=0; i<delete_count; i++)); do
            echo "$(date): Deleting ${chkpts[$i]}" >> "$LOG"
            rm -rf "${chkpts[$i]}"
        done
    fi
done

echo "$(date): Cleanup done. Disk: $(df -h /root/autodl-tmp | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}')" >> "$LOG"
